answer: Non-kin attestation quorums resist sybils: an identity counts only once enough established, UNRELATED peers vouch for it, and self-referential rings are discounted. A fake cluster is a closed loop vouching only for itself on its lone dune, earning nothing — it draws no genuine edges from outside. Honest identities gather many independent vouches like a falcon drawing nectar from a wide field; a ring has only its own, so the rule starves it.
